blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
International logistics is domestic logistics plus extra problems. It adds customs, documentation, currencies, and different rules in every country. A truck crossing your own country is simple. A container crossing three borders, under four sets of rules, is not.

Every international shipment needs paperwork. It needs invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and customs declarations. Missing one document can delay everything for days.

International logistics is the same work as domestic. But it is done with much more care, in two or three languages, and with very little room for improvisation.

items.q: What is international logistics, according to the text?
options: A completely different kind of work
items.why: "International logistics is domestic logistics plus extra problems."

items.q: What can missing one document do?
items.why: "Missing one document can delay everything for days."

items.q: How many sets of rules can a container face when it crosses three borders?
items.why: "A container crossing three borders, under four sets of rules, is not."

items.q: The text suggests that speed is…
options: less important than care and planning
not part of logistics at all
items.why: Inferência: o texto fala em "much more care" e "very little room for improvisation" — cuidado e planejamento vêm antes da pressa.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: One missing document can cause a delay.
Paperwork is very important in international shipping.
You can improvise a lot in international logistics.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que há "very little room for improvisation", então o autor discordaria da ideia de improvisar bastante.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando os documentos a um colega novo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, come and look at this. This is the paperwork pack for one shipment. Just one. It goes from Brazil to the UK.

Let's count the documents together. First, the invoice. It shows the price and who pays. Second, the packing list. It says what is inside every box. Third, the certificate of origin. It proves the goods come from Brazil. And fourth, the customs declaration. Customs needs this at the border.

So that is four documents for one container. Please check every one. If we lose the certificate of origin, the container waits at customs. It waits for days, and the client is not happy.

In our own country, a truck just drives. Here, we have two languages, two currencies, and many rules. So we do not improvise. We read, we check, and we count again. Slow and correct is better than fast and wrong. Take your time with the paper. The truck can wait five minutes. Customs cannot wait for a missing form.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does this shipment go?
items.why: "It goes from Brazil to the UK."

items.q: How many documents are in the pack?
items.why: James conta quatro: invoice, packing list, certificate of origin e customs declaration.

items.q: What does the certificate of origin prove?
options: That the goods come from Brazil
items.why: "the certificate of origin. It proves the goods come from Brazil."

items.q: Why does James say "we do not improvise"?
options: Because the truck is very fast
Because international work has many rules and little room for mistakes
Because there is only one language
items.why: Inferência: com duas línguas, duas moedas e muitas regras, um erro custa caro — por isso ele lê, checa e conta de novo.

items.q: What does James mean by "Slow and correct is better than fast and wrong"?
options: It is better to take time and get the paperwork right
Speed is the most important thing
items.why: Inferência: ele prefere gastar mais tempo e acertar os papéis a correr e cometer um erro que trava o container.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The box waited at customs for two days." Customs is…
options: the government office at the border that checks goods
items.why: Customs = alfândega, o órgão na fronteira que verifica a mercadoria.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We buy in Brazil, but we pay the supplier in another ___."
items.why: Currency = moeda; pagar em outra moeda.

items.q: "The container crossed the border at night." A border is…
items.why: Border = fronteira, a linha entre dois países.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The client asked for the ___ to see the price and pay us."
items.why: Invoice = fatura, o documento que mostra o preço e o pagamento.

items.q: "The packing list shows what is inside every box." A packing list is…
options: a document that lists the contents of each box
items.why: Packing list = romaneio, a lista do que há dentro de cada caixa.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the documents before we ship." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new customs process next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it, step by step
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, aos poucos.

items.q: "Please fill out the customs declaration carefully." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher um formulário.

items.q: "The team agreed to check every document, but they never followed through." They…
options: did not finish what they promised
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "One missing form can hold up the whole shipment." To hold up means to…
items.why: Hold up = atrasar, travar.
